events.text: Follow-up in same thread: added Shift foot brake. GAME_DRIVING gained an optional back-compatible footBrake input — firm decel to a stop from either direction (1.4x brakePower), holds at zero, never reverses (unlike S). Wired to keys.shift() in the lab; controls help + P6 notes updated. S=brake+reverse, Space=drift handbrake unchanged. sha 4fdec304a.

resolution: A/D steering read backwards. The GAME_DRIVING model is internally consistent (front wheels follow the turn direction), so the bug was purely the lab's key→steer sign mapping under the chase camera: A/← was sending -1 and D/→ +1, which turned the car opposite to the expected screen direction. Flipped it — A/← now sends positive steer (screen-left) and D/→ negative (screen-right). One-line change in the input poll, model untouched.
